verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a laptop/desktop processor (APU), not a service that holds user data, so exporting your data and leaving is the wrong axis for this kind of product. Data processed locally stays on the user's own storage. The use of open model formats such as ONNX and llama.cpp covers model portability, not export of user data, so it does not make this story applicable.
